name: Build and Test

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      node-version:
        description: 'Node.js version to use'
        required: false
        type: string
        default: '22'
      rust-toolchain:
        description: 'Rust toolchain to use'
        required: false
        type: string
        default: 'stable'
      target:
        description: 'Target platform'
        required: false
        type: string
      build-command:
        description: 'Build command to run'
        required: false
        type: string
      setup-script:
        description: 'Setup script to run'
        required: false
        type: string
      host:
        description: 'Host runner'
        required: false
        type: string
      docker-image:
        description: 'Docker image to use'
        required: false
        type: string
    outputs:
      artifact-name:
        description: 'Name of the built artifact'
        value: ${{ jobs.build.outputs.artifact-name }}

permissions:
  contents: write
  id-token: write

jobs:
  build:
    name: Build
    runs-on: ${{ inputs.host || 'ubuntu-latest' }}
    outputs:
      artifact-name: ${{ steps.set-artifact-name.outputs.artifact-name }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup pnpm
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: ${{ inputs.node-version || '22' }}
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Setup Rust
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@${{ inputs.rust-toolchain || 'stable' }}
        with:
          components: clippy, rustfmt

      - name: Setup Docker
        if: inputs.docker-image != ''
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3

      - name: Setup Environment
        if: inputs.setup-script != ''
        run: |
          set -euxo pipefail
          ${{ inputs.setup-script }}

      - name: Install Dependencies
        run: pnpm install

      - name: Build
        if: inputs.build-command != ''
        run: ${{ inputs.build-command }}

      - name: Set Artifact Name
        id: set-artifact-name
        run: |
          echo "artifact-name=php-${{ inputs.target }}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Upload Artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: npm-${{ steps.set-artifact-name.outputs.artifact-name }}
          path: |
            ./pkg/*
            !./pkg/**/*.tar.gz
            !./pkg/**/*.tgz
            !./pkg/**/*.zip
          if-no-files-found: error

  test:
    name: Test
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup pnpm
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install Dependencies
        run: pnpm install

      - name: Run Tests
        run: pnpm test

      - name: Upload Test Results
        uses: codecov/test-results-action@v1
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}

  bundle:
    name: Bundle Release
    needs: [build, test]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Download All Artifacts
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          pattern: npm-*
          merge-multiple: true

      - name: Create Release Bundle
        run: |
          mkdir -p release-bundle
          cp -r ./npm-*/* release-bundle/
          tar -czf release-bundle.tar.gz -C release-bundle .

      - name: Upload Release Bundle
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: release-bundle
          path: release-bundle.tar.gz
